verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: logo and buds on the left, the two-line headline in the centre, and price above a pill Shop button on the right. Its flaws are a tiny logo, a cramped product icon, and a price line jammed against the top edge. B's Shop button has turned into a circle that is cut off at the right canvas edge and nearly touches the end of the headline, and its OBSIDIAN logo is shrunk until it is illegible. That leaves a broken CTA and a weak brand mark.
